prompt: Planning a CBC for a new pricing tier. 6 attributes (brand, price, 4 features). Need to compare enterprise vs. SMB segments (roughly 50/50 in our population). What's the right sample size?
assertions: Does NOT give a single rule-of-thumb number without conditioning on precision or subgroup requirements
Asks about or explicitly surfaces required precision (share difference, CI width, etc.)
Discusses per-segment precision floor or minimum sample per segment
Derives n in the 800-1200 range with explicit reasoning
